body:
Ok so I woke up and had done some research on smoking adderall, but to no avail, I tried smoking it out of a pyrex and once off of foil (15mg of adderall XR in each).  I crushed up the beads inside the capsule before I did it.  The only thing that happened was the powder clumped together into a black, tar-like substance, due to the blockers.  All that happened to me was my lungs hurting from the black smoke.
